name: as - as 패턴 PART 01 - "어제만큼 춥진 않아."

keywords.ko: A가 B보다 좋아요 ↔ B는 A보다 나빠요

keywords.en: B is not as [adj] as A

keywords.ko: (A와 B사이에 특징,성향, 경향, 성격을 비교할 때 이 패턴을 사용하는 것임)
cf) 양, 정도, 같은 걸 다른 시점 비교 하는 방법이 훨씬 복잡함.
”저는 친구들만큼 돈을 많이쓰지 않아요”/”친구들은 저만큼 공부를 열심히 하지 않아요”/ “저는 학생이었을 때만큼 친구들을 자주만나지 않아요”
A는 B보다 커요 A is bigger than B
↔ B는 A만큼 크지 않아요 B is not as big as A
B is small than A B가 A보다 작아요.
(big에 반대되는 small이 있어서 smaller을 사용해도 되지만 항상 이런식으로 대응는 단어가 있는 건 아니다.)

keywords.en: My friend is taller than me
↔ I’m not as tall as my friend
I’m shorter than my friend.
Today is colder than yesterday (Today, it’s colder than it was yesterday)
Yesterday wasn’t as cold as today(yesterday it wasn’t as cold as it is today)
I think the remake is better than the original
The original is not as good as the remake
(The original is worse than the remake)
keywords.ko: A가 B보다 좋다"는 얘기는 편하게 느끼는 반면 "B는 A만큼 좋지 않다"는 얘기를 할 때는 이걸 올바르게 얘기하는 사람들이 많지 않을 뿐더러 이런식의 차이점 묘사를 아예 모르고 사용하지 않는 경우가 많다.  하지만 자연스러운 영어 구사를 위해 반드시 알아야 합니다.

keywords.en: A is taller than B
↔ B is not as tall as A
B is shorter than A
My friend is taller than me
↔ I’m not as tall as my friend
I’m shorter than my friend
Today is colder than yesterday(today, it’s colder than it was yesterday)
↔ Yesterday was not as cold as today(yesterday, it wasn’t as cold as it is today)
I think the remake is better than the original
↔ the original is not as good as the remake
(The original is worse than the remake)

my_sentences.en: the book is more interesting than the documentray

my_sentences.ko: ↔ 다큐멘터리는 책만큼 흥미롭지 않다. the documentary is not as interesting as the book

my_sentences.en: The latest model is more expensive than my new phone
My new phone is not as expensive as the latest one
my_sentences.ko: ↔ 내 새 휴대폰은 최신 모델만큼 비싸지 않다

my_sentences.en: The copy is not as clear as the original document
the app is more convenient than the digital version
The digital version is not as convenient as the mobile app
